Description: Single component state for UI controls
State Management: useState or useReducer for complex state
Best Practices: Keep state close to where it's used; lift state only when needed
Code Example: const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false); const toggle = () => setIsOpen(prev => !prev);
Anti-Patterns: Prop drilling multiple levels; global state for local UI
Accessibility Notes: State changes should be announced to screen readers

State Management: useMemo for expensive calculations; derive inline for simple cases
Best Practices: Avoid storing derived data; calculate on render
Code Example: const total = useMemo(() => items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price, 0), [items]);
Anti-Patterns: Storing computed values in state; stale derived data

State Management: useState for simple forms; react-hook-form for complex cases
Best Practices: Use controlled inputs; validate on blur and submit
Code Example: const [email, setEmail] = useState(''); const handleChange = (e) => setEmail(e.target.value);
Anti-Patterns: Uncontrolled inputs with refs; excessive re-renders
Accessibility Notes: Associate errors with inputs using aria-describedby

State Management: Custom hook pattern: { data, isLoading, error }
Best Practices: Handle all states: idle loading success error
Code Example: const [state, setState] = useState({ data: null, isLoading: true, error: null });

State Management: useState with immutable updates; consider useReducer for complex operations
Best Practices: Use unique keys; prefer immutable operations
Code Example: const addItem = (item) => setItems(prev => [...prev, item]); const removeItem = (id) => setItems(prev => prev.filter(i => i.id !== id));
Anti-Patterns: Mutating arrays directly; index as key
Accessibility Notes: Announce list changes to screen readers

Description: Fetching data on mount or dependency change
State Management: useEffect with cleanup; consider React Query or SWR
Best Practices: Handle abort on unmount; cache when possible
Code Example: useEffect(() => { const controller = new AbortController(); fetchData(controller.signal); return () => controller.abort(); }, [dependency]);

State Management: useEffect with cleanup function
Best Practices: Add listener in effect; remove in cleanup
Code Example: useEffect(() => { window.addEventListener('resize', handler); return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', handler); }, [handler]);

State Management: useEffect with cleanup; consider custom hook
Best Practices: Clear timers in cleanup; use refs for mutable values
Code Example: useEffect(() => { const id = setInterval(tick, 1000); return () => clearInterval(id); }, []);
Accessibility Notes: Pause timers when tab not visible

Description: Detecting clicks outside element to dismiss
State Management: useRef + useEffect with document listener
Best Practices: Attach to document; check ref.current.contains
Code Example: useEffect(() => { const handler = (e) => { if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target)) onClose(); }; document.addEventListener('mousedown', handler); return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handler); }, [onClose]);
Anti-Patterns: Missing touch events; wrong event phase
Accessibility Notes: Also close on Escape key press

Description: Arrow key navigation in menus and lists
State Management: useState for focused index; keydown handler
Best Practices: Support arrow keys Home End; wrap focus
Code Example: const handleKeyDown = (e) => { switch(e.key) { case 'ArrowDown': setFocusIndex(i => Math.min(i + 1, items.length - 1)); break; case 'ArrowUp': setFocusIndex(i => Math.max(i - 1, 0)); break; } };

Description: Trapping focus in modals and managing focus flow
State Management: useRef for focus target; useEffect for focus on mount
Best Practices: Trap focus in modals; return focus on close
Code Example: useEffect(() => { const prevFocus = document.activeElement; firstElement.current?.focus(); return () => prevFocus?.focus(); }, []);
Anti-Patterns: Focus escapes modal; lost focus context

Description: Reordering items with drag and drop
State Management: useState for drag state; HTML5 drag API or dnd-kit
Best Practices: Show drop indicator; update state on drop
Code Example: const handleDragEnd = (result) => { if (!result.destination) return; const items = Array.from(list); const [moved] = items.splice(result.source.index, 1); items.splice(result.destination.index, 0, moved); setList(items); };

State Management: IntersectionObserver + useState for items
Best Practices: Use sentinel element; debounce loading
Code Example: const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => { if (entries[0].isIntersecting && hasMore) loadMore(); }); observer.observe(sentinelRef.current);

State Management: useState + throttled scroll listener
Best Practices: Throttle handler; use requestAnimationFrame
Code Example: const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false); useEffect(() => { const handler = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 100); window.addEventListener('scroll', handler, { passive: true }); return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', handler); }, []);

Description: Delaying action until user stops typing
State Management: Custom debounce hook with useRef and setTimeout
Best Practices: 300-500ms delay for search; immediate for UX-critical
Code Example: const [debouncedValue, setDebouncedValue] = useState(value); useEffect(() => { const timer = setTimeout(() => setDebouncedValue(value), delay); return () => clearTimeout(timer); }, [value, delay]);
Anti-Patterns: No debounce on search; API spam

State Management: Custom throttle hook with useRef and timestamps
Best Practices: Use for scroll/resize; 16ms for 60fps
Code Example: const throttle = (fn, limit) => { let lastCall = 0; return (...args) => { const now = Date.now(); if (now - lastCall >= limit) { lastCall = now; fn(...args); } }; };

Description: Animating components on mount and unmount
State Management: AnimatePresence (Framer Motion) or CSS transitions
Best Practices: Use transform and opacity for performance
Code Example: <AnimatePresence>{isVisible && <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }}>Content</motion.div>}</AnimatePresence>

State Management: AnimatePresence with route changes; View Transitions API
Best Practices: Keep transitions fast (200-300ms); use shared elements
Code Example: <AnimatePresence mode='wait'><motion.div key={pathname} initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }}>{children}</motion.div></AnimatePresence>

Description: Animating elements as they enter viewport
State Management: IntersectionObserver or scroll-based library
Best Practices: Animate once; use transform not layout
Code Example: const [ref, inView] = useInView({ triggerOnce: true }); <motion.div ref={ref} initial={{ y: 50, opacity: 0 }} animate={inView ? { y: 0, opacity: 1 } : {}}>Content</motion.div>

Description: Responding to touch and drag gestures
State Management: framer-motion gestures or use-gesture library
Best Practices: Add velocity to feel natural; provide visual feedback
Code Example: <motion.div drag='x' dragConstraints={{ left: -100, right: 100 }} whileDrag={{ scale: 1.02 }}>Draggable</motion.div>

State Management: Update local state immediately; rollback on error
Best Practices: Show undo option; handle errors gracefully
Code Example: const addTodo = async (todo) => { const tempId = Date.now(); setTodos(prev => [...prev, { ...todo, id: tempId }]); try { const result = await api.addTodo(todo); setTodos(prev => prev.map(t => t.id === tempId ? result : t)); } catch { setTodos(prev => prev.filter(t => t.id !== tempId)); showError('Failed'); } };
Anti-Patterns: No error handling; no undo option

State Management: Pass value and onChange; no internal state
Best Practices: Always pair value with onChange handler
Code Example: <Select value={selected} onChange={setSelected} options={options} />

State Management: React.createContext for shared state
Best Practices: Use children or render props; avoid prop drilling
Code Example: <Tabs defaultValue='tab1'><TabsList><TabsTrigger value='tab1'>Tab 1</TabsTrigger></TabsList><TabsContent value='tab1'>Content</TabsContent></Tabs>
Accessibility Notes: Ensure compound components work with a11y

State Management: Pass render function as child or prop
Best Practices: Keep render prop simple; memoize if needed
Code Example: <DataFetcher url='/api/data'>{({ data, isLoading }) => isLoading ? <Spinner /> : <DataList items={data} />}</DataFetcher>
Anti-Patterns: Complex nested render props; callback hell

State Management: Start with 'use'; return values and actions
Best Practices: Keep hooks focused; compose from primitives
Code Example: function useToggle(initial = false) { const [value, setValue] = useState(initial); const toggle = useCallback(() => setValue(v => !v), []); return [value, toggle]; }

Description: Sharing global state across component tree
State Management: React.createContext with Provider component
Best Practices: Use multiple providers for different concerns
Code Example: const ThemeContext = createContext(); function ThemeProvider({ children }) { const [theme, setTheme] = useState('light'); return <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, setTheme }}>{children}</ThemeContext.Provider>; }

Description: Live data updates via WebSocket or SSE
State Management: useEffect for connection; useState for data
Best Practices: Handle reconnection; show connection status
Code Example: useEffect(() => { const ws = new WebSocket(url); ws.onmessage = (e) => setData(JSON.parse(e.data)); return () => ws.close(); }, [url]);

Description: Caching API responses with smart revalidation
State Management: SWR or React Query for automatic caching
Best Practices: stale-while-revalidate; background refresh
Code Example: const { data, error, isLoading } = useSWR('/api/user', fetcher, { refreshInterval: 30000, revalidateOnFocus: true });

Description: Loading data in chunks with page controls
State Management: useState for page; useEffect to fetch
Best Practices: Show total count; handle edge cases
Code Example: const [page, setPage] = useState(1); const { data } = useSWR(`/api/items?page=${page}`); return <>{data?.items.map(item => ...)}<Pagination current={page} total={data?.totalPages} onChange={setPage} /></>;
Anti-Patterns: Loading all data upfront; no loading states
Accessibility Notes: Announce page changes to screen readers

State Management: useState for filters; debounce search input
Best Practices: Combine filters in URL params; debounce typing
Code Example: const [search, setSearch] = useState(''); const debouncedSearch = useDebounce(search, 300); const filtered = items.filter(item => item.name.toLowerCase().includes(debouncedSearch.toLowerCase()));
Anti-Patterns: No debounce; filtering on server for small lists
